A1.justification: Both complete, readable 19-page PDFs describe the same SpecTemp study. Comparison covers all text, equations, tables, figures, references, and supplementary material. Pages 2–19 are textually and visually identical.

before.justification: v1 reports original SpecTemp evaluations on eight benchmarks (Tables 1–2), ablations (Tables 3–8), and visual needle-in-a-haystack results (Figure 8).

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, ablations, retrieval experiments, and qualitative results reported in v1.

M1.justification: The target–draft architecture, iterative frame selection and verification, SFT/GRPO training, and reward components are identical in Section 3 and Algorithm 1.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same SpecTemp-80K training sources, eight evaluation benchmarks, and supplementary visual needle-in-a-haystack scenario. No dataset or task coverage changes.

E2.justification: Tables 1–2 retain identical comparator rows, including Qwen2.5-VL-7B and VideoChat-R1.5. Comparator membership in the ablations and supplementary retrieval evaluation also remains unchanged.

E3.justification: Frame budgets, sampling rates, iteration limits, model sizes, accuracy and latency metrics, and supplementary evaluation procedures are identical in Sections 4 and 6.

E4.justification: Both versions retain the same frame-selection, model-collaboration, training, iteration-count, reward, and frame-allocation ablations, plus latency analysis, retrieval testing, and qualitative case studies.

E5.justification: Point-estimate reporting is unchanged. Neither version reports experimental seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1–8, plotted results including Figure 8, and qualitative findings are identical. No results are added, removed, or corrected.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation and objectives in Equations 1–9 are identical. No definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about dual-model speculative temporal reasoning, SpecTemp-80K, competitive accuracy, and reduced inference latency.

C2.justification: Results interpretations and mechanism explanations are identical. Section 6.4 retains the same limitations concerning dual-model training costs and insufficient evaluation on videos exceeding 2–3 hours.

D1.justification: Implementation settings, training hyperparameters, 16-H100 hardware disclosure, dataset construction details, and prompt templates remain identical. No code or data access information changes.

R1.justification: Section 2, research positioning throughout the paper, and all 90 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: On the title page, 'Alibaba Group' becomes 'Alibaba Group Holding Limited', and Xiaodan Liang's Sun Yat-sen University affiliation and corresponding superscript are removed. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Scientific prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–13, Tables 1–8, captions, and page organization are unchanged. The affiliation edits preserve the title-page arrangement; pages 2–19 render identically.

improvement.justification: v2 changes only affiliation information and the version/date stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility details, limitations, and substantive presentation are identical, establishing no meaningful overall quality difference.
